---
title: "SHMI_Yield: results"
subtitle: "Moore & Manter, Soil health tracks management systems, not the sum of individual practices"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%d %B %Y %H:%M')`"
output:
  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
params:
  log_dir: ""   # a run's folder in Outputs/logs/; "" = the latest run
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# This report only reads Outputs/; it runs no analysis. Run run_all.R first, then:
#   rmarkdown::render("report.Rmd", output_dir = "Outputs")
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, comment = "")
ROOT <- here::here()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = ROOT)
source(file.path(ROOT, "R", "run_helpers.R"))
runs <- sort(list.dirs(file.path(ROOT, "Outputs", "logs"), recursive = FALSE))
LOG_DIR <- if (nzchar(params$log_dir)) params$log_dir else utils::tail(runs, 1)
if (!length(LOG_DIR) || !dir.exists(LOG_DIR)) stop("No run found in Outputs/logs; run run_all.R first.")
MAIN <- file.path(ROOT, "Outputs", "yield_main_default_total_agcros")
STAB <- file.path(ROOT, "Outputs", "yield_stability_default_total_agcros")
FIGS <- file.path(ROOT, "Outputs", "manuscript_figures_default_total_agcros")
```

# The run

Run `r basename(LOG_DIR)`. Logs for each step are in `r LOG_DIR`.

```{r run}
st <- file.path(LOG_DIR, "settings.rds")
if (file.exists(st)) {
  s <- readRDS(st)
  knitr::kable(data.frame(setting = names(s), value = vapply(s, function(v) paste(v, collapse = ", "), "")),
               row.names = FALSE, caption = "Settings")
}
```

```{r steps}
steps <- utils::read.csv(file.path(LOG_DIR, "steps.csv"))
knitr::kable(steps, caption = sprintf("Steps (%.1f min in all)", sum(steps$minutes)))
```

# Soil health (Part A)

Part A is frozen for the paper and off by default; the tables below are shown when its outputs exist.

```{r part-a, results = "asis"}
show_csv(file.path(ROOT, "Outputs", "Benchmark", "benchmark_summary.csv"),
         "Fig. 2d and Supplementary Data Table 4: SHMI against its parts and unconstrained models")
show_csv(file.path(ROOT, "Outputs", "Calib_scenarios", "scenario_summary.csv"),
         "Supplementary Data Fig. 1: weights by comparison")
```

# Corn yield (Part B)

```{r part-b, results = "asis"}
show_csv(file.path(MAIN, "results_main.csv"), "Fig. 3 model: within-site slope, SHMI x N, SHMI x age")
show_csv(file.path(MAIN, "N_equivalent.csv"), "Fertilizer-N equivalent of 10 SHMI points")
show_csv(file.path(MAIN, "mediation_results.csv"), "Supplementary Data Table 3: soil properties as carriers of the slope")
show_csv(file.path(STAB, "stability_results.csv"), "Fig. 4: year conditions, drought, worst years")
show_csv(file.path(MAIN, "N_scenarios_all_sites.csv"), "N-accounting scenarios (all sites)")
show_csv(file.path(ROOT, "Outputs", "yield_weights_agcros", "weights_slopes.csv"), "Yield slope by weight set")
show_csv(file.path(ROOT, "Outputs", "Coarse", "coarse_napeshm.csv"), "Coarse records: skill against soil health")
show_csv(file.path(ROOT, "Outputs", "Coarse", "coarse_yield.csv"), "Coarse records: within-site yield slope")
```
